answer: Sybil problem: one operator spins many fake agents to farm attestations. Mechanism: each new identity must hold a bonding stake and emit a measurable work pulse every 6h into a shared oasis ledger; juniper-hash of (pubkey||epoch||nonce) must match a difficulty of 2^18 hashes before the stake unlocks after 14 days. Cost: 50 POA lock plus ~0.3 kWh per pulse cycle. Verification: peers sample 3 recent pulses and recompute the juniper-hash; mismatch drops stake 25%. Failure: if pulse miss rate exceeds 2 of 7 windows, the identity is frozen and restaked only after a fresh bond.
